text:
mari: Canary hit — seeing a regression in prefill TTFT on long-context runs when fp8 kernels are selected under adaptive batching. TPS unchanged, but p95 prefill jumps ~35%. Anyone else noticing this?

devin: saw a blip Friday on the dedicated cluster, thought it was noise. do you have canary id?

mari: canary-20260307-42. Perf alert from CI attached. perf-bot flagged prefill_latency_p95 +35% for model=rwd-7b-fp8.

perf-bot: CI alert: metric=server.prefill_latency_p95, baseline=78ms, canary=105ms, delta=+34.6% (sig=0.002)

ashley: quick glance at flamegraphs — the hot path is the KV cache dequant loop during prefill. looks like we flip kernels mid-prefill and end up doing redundant dequant/quant cycles.

sam: can you paste the profile snippet?

mari: pasting the relevant stack (from perf trace):
```
# prefill top stacks (hotspots)
1) runtime.kv.dequantize_batches  42%
2) kernel.selector.swap_to_fp8    18%
3) runtime.kv.write_async         12%
4) batching.scheduler.merge       8%
```

liam: that 2) is interesting — kernel swap should be cheap, but if we trigger it repeatedly inside a microbatch window it will blow up due to repeated dequant allocations.

ashley: hypothesis: adaptive-batching threshold flips for fp8 (because it gives better per-token throughput at larger batch sizes) but for longctx prefills the amortization point moves — we end up swapping kernels after some prefixes have populated KV, causing extra dequant work.

mari: also saw increased memory churn in the canary logs: evictions + re-materialize of dequant buffers. snippet: \`kv.cache.evictions=231\`, \`dequant.allocs=18k\` over a 10m window.

sam: concrete mitigation ideas: 1) add a hysteresis window for kernel swaps (delay N ms after a swap before another), 2) amortize the dequant work by batching dequant operations across microbatches, 3) prefer keeping kernel pinned for a request if any prefix touched KV.

liam: +1 for kernel-pinning by request. cheap to implement: selector.keep_alive_for_req = true. downside: could lose some TPS on short requests.

ashley: we can try a middle ground: selector.swap_policy = "amortize_kv_dequant" with parameters: 
```json
{ "min_swap_cooldown_ms": 200, "min_amortize_items": 4, "dequant_batch_size": 256 }
```
this batches the dequant ops and prevents swap if the amortized cost would exceed benefit.

mari: can we run two experiments: A) keep pin-by-request on canary for longctx (>2048) only, B) enable amortize_kv_dequant with cooldown 200ms on entire fleet-canary? I'll run A and sam can run B.

sam: starting B now on canary-20260307-43 with config: \`amortize_kv_dequant=true cooldown_ms=200\`. I'll push a short-run perf harness: \`tools/bench_longctx.sh --model rwd-7b --quant fp8 --runs 500 --adaptive-batching\`.

perf-bot: scheduled benchmark job 98342 for canary-20260307-43.

ashley: also add a diagnostic counter: \`kernel.swap_count_per_req\` and \`dequant_ops_merged\` so we can correlate improvement.

liam: note: if we reduce swap frequency too much we might route suboptimally to int8 and lose cost wins. track token_per_sec and cost_per_token.

mari: agreed — include metrics: prefill_p95, decode_p95, tps, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_token. I'll collect traces + heap profiles for A.

sam: run finished on B (short). initial numbers: prefill_p95 down 22% vs canary baseline, tps -1.9%, tokens_per_sec -0.5%. dequant_ops_merged ~ 78% increase (good). attaching trace id 1234.

mari: great. I'll validate A tomorrow morning and post full numbers. If both look sane we can add amortize_kv_dequant behind feature flag and enable for longctx models only.

ops-bot: reminder: any canary config changes should include rollback tag and perf-sla-checker hook.

devin: follow-up — can we add a quick microbenchmark that simulates long-prefix mixes (50% short, 50% long) to measure mixed workload impact? That will surface TPS/TTFT tradeoffs.

ashley: good call. I'll add a synthetic mix to the bench script (mix_ratio param). Also will add a debug trace to record whether kernel pinning decisions were made per-request.

mari: thanks all — filing a short RFC for the amortize_kv_dequant heuristic with initial params + experiment plan. will link here when done.

sam: thanks — will post bench artifacts and flamegraphs under canary-20260307-43/trace-1234.

mari: OK closing thread for now, will update after A results. :thumbsup:
